message: 初めての、すごい、牛丼

name: Sally
message: 「And then! When I helped carry the luggage, he treated me to meat buns!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah~」

name: Sally
message: 「Oyabin's super strong, considering how huge he is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to eat meat buns too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Food tastes way better after you've worked for it!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah! Right now I feel like I could take on anything and everything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan. You've really changed.」

name: Misa
message: 「Her help with the KiraFes ended up being a huge success, too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess demons aren't so bad after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe it's all thanks to you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, it's thanks to everyone.」

name: Ria
message: 「You think so~?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed it is. Only bringing up collective responsibility when someone does something bad is absurd beyond belief.」

name: Sally
message: 「Look who's talking. Even though you discriminated against me at first just for being a demon!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Equality and fairness. Those are my mottos.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan worked really hard for us... Wonder if the Student Council could do something to thank her?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh! That sounds great.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaaay! Are you gonna treat me to something yummy again--!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm~~. It's always the exact same pattern with you. Can't we show our thanks in some other way?」

name: Sally
message: 「I won't ask for anything fancy! Even gyudon would be totally fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, Nanaka's right. If we're gonna do this, I'd rather do something that actually benefits her instead of just giving her physical stuff.」

name: Ria
message: 「Food just goes straight into your stomach and disappears, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan. Do you love beef bowls?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah! Love 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「Does the Boss like beef bowls too?」

name: Sally
message: 「Super loves 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case. Why don't you try working at a beef bowl shop?」

name: Ria
message: 「I seee! That's a great idea.」

name: Sally
message: 「What happens if I work?」

name: Synn
message: 「You might get to eat beef bowls every day!」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!? Then I'll do it! I'll do it right now!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're introducing Sally-chan to a part-time job, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. And it'd be great if they'd hire Eauderourke along with her, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「E-Even so, that's... I wonder about that~\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「With your recommendation, it'll be a piece of cake.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're giving me too much credit. I hope it goes well, though... Well, let's ask on the off chance.」
Explaining the situation to Eauderourke as well, we head to the beef bowl shop together.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, he looks like that, sure, but I think he'll do a solid job. Yes, in various ways--」
Negotiations begin along those lines.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at that, Sally-chan. Synn is trying so hard so the two of you can work at the beef bowl shop.」

name: Sally
message: 「Sniff, Prez. For our sake...」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, moved. Work, do best.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right, you two. Synn-kun believes in both of you, so you have to properly live up to that.」

name: Sally
message: 「Believes in us...?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, me, believe. Me, Prez, believe.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Beef bowl, eat.」

name: Sally
message: 「Eat a ton of 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcome back! How did it go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Double peace signs!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Way to go, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「They said they won't just give them beef bowls as staff meals, they'll pay them a proper salary too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Salary? Does that mean we even get money?」

name: Synn
message: 「Make sure you save it up properly.」

name: Sally
message: 「We get to eat beef bowls, and even get money on top of it... This isn't a dream, right, Boss!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Dream, no. Cheek, hurts.」

name: Synn
message: 「The manager said he saw the two of you working hard at KiraFes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And he agreed right away on account of that? What a classy guy that manager is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good for you two. Do your best starting tomorrow.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay♪ I love you, Prez.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, love you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah, stop it--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Sally
message: 「Kaboom!」
And so, Eauderourke and Sally happily broke new ground as residents of Ryuusei Town.

name: Sally
message: 「If you're ever in trouble, Prez, don't hesitate to call us. We'll come flying right over!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, help out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks... So, first off, could you guys get off of me...」
Sally joined the party!
Eauderourke joined the party!
